quotes.text: We cache the URI because sendMailMessage uses it to store error

In the 2024 send path, SmtpServer cached nsIURI because client.onerror attached failedSecInfo and errorMessage to it; the delivery URL listener later read the same object to form the user-facing error. Port and username changes cleared the cache. D203799 first challenged the cache as mutable state, then accepted its identity requirement and asked for the explanatory code comment. Do not replace this cache with a fresh URI per access without first changing the error transport. The later Bug 2069949 made the getter nullable for incomplete or malformed servers, so callers must handle null.
